title: nnU-Net: Self-adapting Framework for U-Net-Based Medical Image Segmentation
layout_note: The figure shows only the U-Net cascade component of the framework, as two side-by-side stage panels.
grouping: Two grey background panels titled in lowercase at their top-left: a wider, darker 'stage 1' and a narrower, lighter 'stage 2'. A separate grey strip across the bottom holds the legend.
shapes_depth: Everything is schematic: images and segmentations are flat parallelograms in perspective (grey = full-res image, blue = low-res seg, green on pale green = full-res seg); each U-Net is an unlabelled light-grey 3-D bow-tie (hourglass) solid with a few thin lines inside for skips. Black dotted lines joining plane corners form frustums for down/upsampling; a red outlined rectangle marks the crop, with red dotted lines carrying it into stage 2; a thin grey arc is the skip of the full-res image past the first U-Net.
proposed_highlight: Nothing is accented; the cascade is conveyed by the two stage panels, and the red crop outline is the only saturated line colour.
lesson: Show resampling between resolutions as dotted frustum lines joining the corners of a large and a small plane, so down- and up-sampling read geometrically without any arrow or label.
notes: Venue/year: arXiv 2018 (year = arXiv preprint year); no venue printed on the arXiv PDF (the later Nature Methods 2021 nnU-Net paper is a different publication). This is the paper's only figure; it depicts the cascade, not the full self-configuring pipeline. elements 'other' = perspective planes standing in for images.

core.what: a two-stage cascade drawn as two tinted panels left to right: stage 1 downsamples the image, segments it at low resolution and upsamples; a red-outlined crop of image plus segmentation feeds stage 2's U-Net and full-res output

relations.form: two grey background panels, 'stage 1' wide and darker on the left and 'stage 2' narrower and lighter on the right, each holding its own bow-tie U-Net glyph
within stage 1 the image plane shrinks through a dotted frustum into the bow-tie and its blue low-res output grows back through another frustum, read left to right
the upsampled blue segmentation and the full-res grey image are stacked as overlapping planes before being cropped together for stage 2
a red outline marks the crop on the stacked planes and red dotted lines carry the cropped pair to stage 2's input

channels.colour: grey plane = full-res image, blue = low-res segmentation, green = full-res segmentation, red outline = cropping, as keyed in the bottom legend
channels.shape: flat planes in perspective = data, grey bow-tie solid = a U-Net
channels.line: black dotted = up/downsampling frustum, thin grey arc = skip connection, red dotted = crop hand-off

quality.strengths: Data are drawn as data (planes whose size shows resolution), every colour and line style is keyed once in a legend strip, and the two stages are separated as panels with the hand-off made explicit by the red crop.
quality.weaknesses: The U-Nets are unlabelled glyphs; the stage-1 upsampling frustum and the stacked blue/grey planes overlap so the concatenation step is hard to see; the long grey skip arc over stage 1 is a decorative wire; stage 2's green output plane is floating with no arrow.

insights.structure: Two grey stage panels sit side by side (stage 1 wider and darker, stage 2 narrower and lighter) above a full-width legend strip.
insights.data: Images and segmentations are flat coloured planes in perspective (grey image, blue low-res seg, green full-res seg) and each U-Net is an unlabelled grey bow-tie solid.
insights.emphasis: No module is highlighted; the only saturated line colour is the red crop outline that carries a patch from stage 1 into stage 2.
insights.flow: Left to right: image planes shrink through a dotted frustum into the first bow-tie, its blue output grows back through another frustum, and red dotted lines hand the cropped stack to stage 2's bow-tie and green output.
insights.avoid: The U-Nets are unlabelled glyphs and the stage-1 frustum lines overlap the stacked blue and grey planes, so the upsample-then-concatenate step is hard to separate without the caption.

arrangement.units: two grey tinted background panels, 'stage 1' (wide) and 'stage 2', titled at top-left
arrangement.inputs_as: a schematic grey plane (no real scan)
arrangement.shared: none: each stage has its own bow-tie U-Net glyph

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
